SELECT nextval('team_tb_team_id_seq')
INSERT INTO TEAM_TB(team_id, name, create_time, create_user_id, uuid, status) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{name}, #{createTime}, #{createUserId}, #{uuid}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT team.team_id, team.name, team.create_time, team.create_user_id, team.uuid, team.status, creator.name as createUserName, team.modify_user_id, modifier.name as modifyUserName FROM team_tb team JOIN user_tb creator ON creator.user_id = team.create_user_id LEFT JOIN user_tb modifier on modifier.user_id = team.modify_user WHERE team.uuid = #{teamUuid}

/** selectTeam*/ SELECT team.team_id, team.name, team.create_time, team.create_user_id as createUser, team.modify_time, team.modify_user_id, team.uuid, team.status FROM team_tb team JOIN user_tb user_tb ON user_tb.user_id = team.create_user_id WHERE team.uuid = #{teamUuid}

/** selectTeamByTeamId*/ SELECT team.team_id, team.name, team.create_time, team.create_user_id as createUser, team.modify_time, team.modify_user_id, team.uuid, team.status FROM team_tb team JOIN user_tb user_tb ON user_tb.user_id = team.create_user_id WHERE team.team_id = #{teamId}
mapper.update: UPDATE team_tb SET name = #{name}, modify_time = #{currentTime} WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
UPDATE team_tb SET status = #{teamStatus}, modify_time = #{currentTime} WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
mapper.select: SELECT team.name, team.create_time, team.uuid, team.status, user_tb.name as createUser FROM team_tb team JOIN user_tb user_tb ON user_tb.user_id = team.create_user_id WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM rel_user_team_tb relation WHERE relation.team_id = team.team_id AND relation.user_id = #{userId} )
